Reproduced on merged main against the locked passlib 1.7.4/bcrypt 4.0.1: verify_password(plain, '$2b$12$') and verify_password(plain, '$2b$12$short') raise ValueError('salt too small (bcrypt requires exactly 22 chars)') and verify_password(plain, '$2y$05$' + 22 chars) raises ValueError('expected bcrypt hash, got bcrypt config string instead'); none is UnknownHashError, so all three propagate out of t7. authenticate_user wraps the call in `except ValueError:` and returns None (after a verify_dummy call to keep the cost profile), so login_user raises 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS and never a 500. Builder traps discovered by probing the merged environment and all documented in the issue: (1) pydantic.EmailStr is UNUSABLE - email-validator is absent from uv.lock and t8 adds no dependencies, so an EmailStr annotation raises ImportError at model import time (reproduced); a field_validator + pattern ^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$ is mandated instead, with the bcrypt ceiling enforced on UTF-8 BYTE length; (2) ruff B008 (B is selected) rejects `param: T = Depends(...)` - the Annotated[T, Depends(...)] form is mandated (a pyproject lint relaxation would be out-of-scope config churn); (3) jose ships no py.typed so every importing module needs t7's file-level '# mypy: disable-error-code="import-untyped"'; (4) mypy strict: LoginResponse(user=<ORM User>) is an arg-type error (build UserResponse.model_validate with from_attributes=True), a cast of an already-correct tuple is a redundant-cast error, and session.execute(text(...)) results have no rowcount attribute (cast to Any in tests); (5) FastAPI 0.142's app.routes contains _IncludedRouter objects with no .path - registration order must be asserted via app.openapi()['paths'] key order (verified to preserve it); (6) a get_db override is a generator function, so `with override()` raises TypeError - use `with next(override()) as session:`; (7) HTTPBearer(auto_error=False) is required or a missing header yields FastAPI's built-in shape instead of our UNAUTHORIZED; (8) t7's TokenError carries no reason code, so TOKEN_EXPIRED vs TOKEN_INVALID must be distinguished via exc.__cause__ is jose.ExpiredSignatureError, not by re-running validation; (9) the expired-token test mints with JWT_ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES=-1 + cache_clear then restores 1440 (no sleeps, no freezegun); (10) logging must go through a module logger with extra={'extra_fields': {...}} and never near a raw email/password/token.
